marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Monday.
marine.text:
Wind east 30 knots diminishing to northeast 20 near noon
Monday. Scattered flurries with a risk of freezing drizzle changing
to snow this afternoon then to scattered flurries near noon Monday. Visibility
as low as 1 mile in snow. Temperatures minus 2 falling to minus 14 Monday
evening. Over open water freezing spray beginning this
afternoon. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Monday.
marine.text:
Over open water seas 1 metre building to 2 near noon then
subsiding to 1 Monday morning.<br/>
